notes.title: WATCH DEVELOPER PLAYS
notes.notes: During the livestream, you will have the unique opportunity to experience the thrilling gameplay and explore the intricately designed environments of Raconteur. Whether you're a fan eagerly awaiting its release or a newcomer excited to get a glimpse into the world of indie gaming, this event is for you. Engage with the developer as they guide you through the demo, sharing their creative process and providing valuable commentary along the way.
